title: [SOLVED] Daily display freezes on RTX 3070
body: I, or more accurately my friend, has been having strange freezing issues since switching from Windows 10 to Arch Linux. We've been trying to diagnose them for a few days now, and we are pretty stumped. Basically his monitors keep freezing occasionally. Most often it's his main monitor, but there have been a few cases of the others freezing too. There are no other artifacts or flickering on any of the displays. The freezes usually recover after some seconds/minutes. They might happen more often during gaming, but they also happen when just watching youtube videos. Interestingly a screenshot taken during the freeze shows a more up to date version of the frozen display than what's visible on the monitor, meaning things still keep updating in the background. Basic info about the system: Operating System: Arch Linux KDE Plasma Version: 6.8.1 KDE Frameworks Version: 6.31.0 Qt Version: 6.12.0 Kernel Version: 7.2.11-arch1-1 (64-bit) Graphics Platform: Wayland Processors: 12 × AMD Ryzen 5 5600X 6-Core Processor Memory: 34 GB of RAM (33.6 GB usable) Graphics Processor: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Manufacturer: Gigabyte Technology Co., Ltd. Product Name: B550 AORUS ELITE V2 His monitor setup is like this: left monitor -> native HDMI 1080p main monitor -> native DP 4k right monitor -> HDMI (monitor) to DP (PC) 1080p All three are set to 60 Hz. No VRR on any of them. The system has the nvidia-open kernel driver and the proprietary drivers from nvidia-utils. He used the archinstall script for the install. Attempted fixes so far: - Switching from nvidia-open to nvidia-580xx-dkms, including disabling the GSP firmware. Seemingly made the freezes even worse(?) – Using the KWIN_DRM_NO_DIRECT_SCANOUT=1 environment variable. Doesn't seem to help. - Turned on Re-Size BAR. Fixed some unrelated issues but not the freezes. - Stop using waywallen (wall paper engine for linux), since it was spamming the logs. Didn't stop the freezes. Here's some logs we gathered during one of the freezes. There were two separate freezes close to each other that happened around 17:00.
